answer: The stake is a hostage, not a fee: 25 POA per identity, released only after 14 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 715 fakes must lock 17875 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The mirror of the hostage is the deterrent, the ridge of the slow release is the filter, and the beacon of the burn is the punishment.
